subject: Library Generated filter: accepted
body: Accepted. Library mounts `apps/web/src/generation/GeneratedLibrary.tsx` for filter value `generated` (chip label `generation.library.filter`), shown only while the `generation` flag is on. `GET /api/library` lists uploads, KB entries and private chapters only; generated_media never appear in ingest/KB listings, never in `accepts`, and never in the storage-used sum's item list (the meter does count `generated-media` bytes under your own row prefix only if you want — tell me; default: not counted, since it is a separate bucket). Ingest never reads generated_media.
